evidence.title: Anthropic will be 'most ridiculous IPO' of year, analyst says

occurrences.checkable_against: New Constructs report dated October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: In a report on Tuesday, independent financial research provider New Constructs called Anthropic's upcoming offering the "most ridiculous IPO of 2026."
occurrences.speaker: New Constructs
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: Nvidia quarterly financial statements for the four quarters preceding October 7, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: Nvidia's net income over the past four quarters topped $190 billion.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: New Constructs research report on Anthropic
occurrences.quote_span: "Since the arrival of open-source models, it's been clear that the closed models would struggle to generate profits," the firm wrote.
occurrences.speaker: New Constructs
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: New Constructs research report on Anthropic
occurrences.quote_span: Anthropic's mounting operating losses coupled with emerging competition from a plethora of open-source models led New Constructs to conclude that, "We don't think Anthropic has a viable business."
occurrences.speaker: New Constructs
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: Anthropic statement on AI risk cited by New Constructs
occurrences.quote_span: The New Constructs report also notes that Anthropic's assertion that AI could pose "a catastrophic or existential risk to humanity" is another reason why investors should avoid the IPO.
occurrences.speaker: Anthropic
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: Anthropic statement on annualized revenue run rate at the end of July 2026
occurrences.quote_span: Anthropic claimed at the end of July that its annualized revenue run rate was up sevenfold year-over-year to $65 billion.
occurrences.speaker: Anthropic
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: New York Times September 2026 report on Anthropic's annualized revenue
occurrences.quote_span: including from the New York Times, which reported in September that the company was on pace to generate $100 billion in annualized revenue by the end of 2026.
occurrences.speaker: The New York Times
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: Anthropic 2025 financial statements or the leaked prospectus cited by Reuters
occurrences.quote_span: Meanwhile, Anthropic's revenue in 2025 was $4.6 billion as the company racked up a net loss of $42 billion, according to Reuters, which cited a leaked copy of the company's prospectus.
occurrences.speaker: Reuters
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: New Constructs research report and Nvidia financial statements
occurrences.quote_span: To reach its desired valuation, the firm estimates Anthropic would need to record double the trailing year of profit for Nvidia, the world's most valuable tech company.
occurrences.speaker: New Constructs
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: Anthropic public filings and prospectus records
occurrences.quote_span: Anthropic still hasn't made its prospectus public, so New Constructs hasn't seen the actual filing.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: New Constructs research report on Anthropic's proposed IPO
occurrences.quote_span: "While Anthropic offers more to society than WeWork ever did, at a $2 trillion valuation, its IPO presents far bigger risks and is positioned to be a far bigger rip off of U.S. capital markets," New Constructs wrote, adding that the IPO's purpose isn't to provide wealth for public markets investors, but rather liquidity for the company's Wall Street backers.
occurrences.speaker: New Constructs
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: Anthropic 2025 financial statements or the leaked prospectus cited by Reuters
occurrences.quote_span: Meanwhile, Anthropic's revenue in 2025 was $4.6 billion as the company racked up a net loss of $42 billion, according to Reuters, which cited a leaked copy of the company's prospectus.
occurrences.speaker: Reuters
occurrences.subject: Anthropic

occurrences.checkable_against: New Constructs research report on Anthropic's valuation
occurrences.quote_span: As Anthropic barrels toward a potential $2 trillion market cap on the Nasdaq, one research firm is valuing the artificial intelligence company at a mere $150 billion and says Wall Street is about to face an "unprecedented test of investor gullibility."
occurrences.speaker: New Constructs
occurrences.subject: Anthropic
